CustomField.description: Tax rate (percent) returned by SapTaxCalculationService. Examples: 19.00 for DE standard VAT, 20.00 for AT, 7.70 for CH, 21.00 for NL, 20.00 for FR. Picks up reduced rates (7% DE for some product categories) once the SAP_Material_Number__c is populated with reduced-rate-classified products.
CustomField.label: SAP Tax Rate
